About this item

  • 【Bubble Free Built-in 9H Glass Screen Protector】Miracase for iPhone 16 pro case with built-in full screen protector protect your phone screen from scratches and cracks, no gap and won't lift up the screen,and making you enjoy the sensitive touch without bubbles
  • 【Full-Body Protection & Unique Camera Control 】Military-grade 8000 times drop tested. Dual layer provides truly 360 ° no dead angle full body protection. The camera precisely protected is completely non-destructive picture quality. Different from other brands' direct hole digging design, Miracase unique camera control design focuses more on the overall protection of the phone, preserving the original camera control touch usage experience and providing a more comfortable grip
  • 【Fit All Magnet Accessories】Miracase iPhone 16 pro phone case Built in upgraded 3rd generation magnet ring, locking and compatible with magsafe accessories, wireless charging is faster, easier, and safer. The powerful magnetism support charging from any angle, and there is no need to worry about the charger separating from the phone anymore
  • 【Never Yellow Crystal Clear】Diamond hard clear back to show off the real color of your iPhone 16 Pro, always clear new as day 1
  • 【PRODUCT SUPPORT】Any product issues please contact us for a replacement. Installation: install the front cover with iPhone - install the back cover from the bottom; Removal: press the bottom cover from the bottom to separate the case

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    My go to phone case
    This is the phone case i always come back to no matter what. Im very clumsy so I drop my phone a lot, and in one case I dropped it from a table onto the concrete and I saw a really bad crack, and I got scared since this was a newer phone, and to my relief, the phone case took it all, without a single scratch on my phone. The magnet on the magsafe case holds great, and I have to yank or slide off with quite a bit of force when I want to take my portable charger off of it. The case also comes with a camera protector, and every time I put a new case the phone looks like new. My only issue is that it doesnt come with a cloth to clean any dirt off the phone when switching to this case. Another issue I had is that the case does get dirty, but that may be a user issue on my end. It gets dirty internally somehow, but that could be from moments where I take the case off or when I leave it in the sand at the beach. TLDR: this case saved my phone like 5 times and my camera about 2, and it has never failed me yet and leaves my phone looking brand new with the magsafe cases having a strong grip. Works like a more expensive case for a nicer pricepoint.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Amazing protection for the price! Only replacing to upgrade to MagSafe.
      Reviewed in the United States on June 6, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      If you are looking for a good case that completely surrounds your device, look no further!

      I bought this as an Otterbox style (thought not fully waterproof) protective case for my iPhone 14. It’s lasted me quite well, but wasn’t a MagSafe version. (That is literally my only complaint.) It meets my needs and is far more capable than the price would indicate. So much so that I am upgrading to a MagSafe version in a slightly different color without hesitation or regret!

      The glass screen protector has maintained superb clarity despite’s bumps, drops, spills, and even flinging my phone down a hill (on accident). I think the hilly road surface would have caused more harm, but just 2 1/4” scratches resulted. The clarity and usefulness were not affected, and I have to shine a light across the screen to even spot where the damage happened.

      Because of the double layered edges, this gives really good shock and impact protection. Drops only concrete, asphalt, and tile have cause zero damage to the case or phone. The thicker edges help my grip and make this easier to hold onto, but I have large hands. Despite that this still fits neatly into a belt holster without issue.

      The case seals well enough, but at the same time it’s not hard to open to clear a speck of dust or drop of moisture off the screen before resealing it. I have dropped my phone into a running shower for almost zero moisture getting into the case.

      I highly recommend this case as someone who isn’t gentle and often a klutz while handling my electronics.

    • JSH
      4 out of 5 stars
      Weak spot is integrated screen protector
      Reviewed in the United States on May 25, 2026
      Size: iPhone 17Color: Clear
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Overall, I am happy with this case.

      Positives: Plastic is slightly soft to the touch so it’s lightly grippy. It doesn’t show fingerprints. Screen cover does show skin oil, but it polishes off easily with microfiber. It looks very nice and lets the color of the phone show through. Light refracts through the clear plastic giving it a muted crystal appearance. The case is rugged and protects the phone very well. It works perfectly with my Anker magnetic charger or plug in usb-c cord.

      Negatives: I purchased my iPhone 17 with a screen protector. This case has a built in screen protector. It is part of the design. It can’t be removed. When you install the case, you first install the top piece that encloses the sides of the phone and includes the screen protector. Then the bottom of the case snaps on over the sides of the top. This makes the case very sturdy. But if you already have a screen protector under the case screen protector, it desensitizes the screen. It bothers me most when typing. Missed letters and such. There is an adjustment on the phone to increase screen sensitivity. It helps significantly, but not completely. I’m learning to tap harder.

      Update - I’ve been using this case for over a month. Two things I mentioned in my earlier review have become daily aggravations and I have decided to go with another case. The main problem is the screen desensitivity because of 2 layers of screen protection. It’s a constant issue. The logical fix would be to remove the $40 screen protector I paid Apple to install. I’m familiar with this product from previous phones. It is excellent. It’s fingerprint resistant. It causes no screen desensitization. It stays perfectly clear. You forget it’s there. That leads to the secondary issue. The phone case’s screen protector shows fingerprints and facial oil. It wipes off easily, but it’s not as clear as it was a month ago. My choice of removing a screen protector is to remove the case’s screen protector and since it is integrated… goodbye case. Having 2 screen protectors is not Miracase’s fault. But having the 2nd best screen protector integrated is the reason I’m reducing my rating from 5 to 4 stars.

      On the way to the hospital, going 50 mph. I heard a thump and saw a flash in my rear-view mirror. That's when I remembered I put my iPhone 17 Pro Max on the car roof. I'd only had it for two weeks! I saw it tumbling on the road behind me. I turned as soon as I could. I raced back to see it lying on the berm. I got out of the car and ran to the phone. The screen was not cracked, and all the buttons work fine. I am very glad I got this case for my iPhone.

      4 out of 5 stars
      HONEST REVIEW: AFTER HAVING THIS BRANDS CASES FOR 5 YEARS.
      Reviewed in the United States on September 6, 2026
      Size: iPhone 17 ProColor: Pink
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I never write amazon reviews but this one felt like it deserved one. This is my 4th time repurchasing this case over the course of. 5 years. (That’s due to buying new phones). I keep coming back because for someone who drops their phone ALL. THE. TIME, none of my phones have ever scratched or cracked. They were always in perfect condition.

      The case itself after a few years had minor wear and tear, but that’s a given if you drop it a lot like me. The feel is great, it honestly doesn’t feel bulky at all. I have smaller hands so I appreciate this case not making my phone feel much bigger.

      Now, the reason I gave it 4.5 stars instead of a solid 5 is because although purposely it does an amazing job protecting the phone, I find that the inside of the case and rim of the case does accumulate dust and dirt considering I haven’t opened up this case often. If kept clean often, maybe once a week this is avoidable tho.

      Also, a few years back with a an older version of cases from this brand, I used to carry a card at the back of the case and take it out every day to use it (having to open up the case very often), and that case got very loose to a noticeable extent. So I wouldn’t recommend doing that for this case if you’re that kind of person. I didn’t take off any stars for this because this part was my fault. I still thought it was worth mentioning.

      I do wish they had more color variety for the new privacy screen version of this product. I wanted that one in pink, but they didn’t have it for my model so im going back to this non privacy design.

      Overall, I love this brands cases a lot. This will always be my go-to case whenever getting a new phone. I’m currently repurchasing my 5th case as I just bought a 17 pro. Hopefully I covered most of not all aspects of this case. I hope this review helped you in some way!
